# Modeling PseudoCode

```{r}
# Data load
data <- read.csv(train.csv)
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
param1_grid <- c()
param2_grid <- c()


for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in param1_grid){
    for(param2 in param2_grid){
      
      print("param1")
      print(param1)
      print("param2")
      print(param2)
      
      for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
        CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
        train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
        train_index <- c(1:n) 
        train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
        test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
        test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
        # Train index가 필요한 경우
        Model <- Model(target ~ ., data = data, subset = train_index, p1 = param1, p2 = param2)
        # Train 데이터셋이 필요한 경우
        Model <- Model(target ~ ., data = train, p1 = param1, p2 = param2)
        
        
        # Prediction (0, 1로 나오는 경우)
        pred <- predict(Model, newdata = test)
        
        # Prediction이 확률로 나오는 경우
        prob_pred <- predict(Model, newdata = test)
        pred <- rep(0, test_rowNum)
        pred[prob_pred > threshold] <- 1 # threshold에는 Threshold grid 있을 시에는 param을, 아니면 숫자로 넣어줌.
        
        # Update Scores
        Accuracy_Model[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_Model[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
        FPR_Model[[seed]] <- c(FPR_Model[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
        FNR_Model[[seed]] <- c(FNR_Model[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
        F1_Model[[seed]] <- c(F1_Model[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))
      }
      
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_Model <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(param1_grid)){
    for(param2 in 1:length(param2_grid)){
      CVAccuracy_Model[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_Model[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_Model[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFPR_Model[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_Model[[seed]], mean(FPR_Model[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFNR_Model[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_Model[[seed]], mean(FNR_Model[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVF1_Model[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_Model[[seed]], mean(F1_Model[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
    }
  }
}
```
